subject.name: History
subject.textbook: CUP Option B: the 20th Century 3rd ed.
subject.examPattern: Paper 1 Structured 2 h, 60 marks (40%): answer 2 of 8 core questions + 1 depth-study question, each in parts (a)(b)(c). Paper 2 Document questions 1 h 45, 40 marks (30%): 1 question, 5 parts, up to 7 sources. Component 3 Coursework (2,000 words) or Paper 4 Alternative 1 h, 40 marks (30%). Model writes all 18 P1 questions + P2 + P4.

items.name: Historical Skills: Explaining, Analysing and Using Sources
Background: The First World War and the World in 1918
Were the Peace Treaties of 1919-23 Fair?
To What Extent Was the League of Nations a Success?
Why Had International Peace Collapsed by 1939?
Who Was to Blame for the Cold War?
How Effectively Did the USA Contain the Spread of Communism?
How Secure Was the USSR's Control over Eastern Europe, 1948-c.1989?
